name: Benday
author: E. T. Carter
description: Pop-art Ben-Day dots — a regular screen of bold flat dots over a light newsprint ground, each dot taking its colour from a drifting field underneath so colour blocks roll across the grid. Bright, graphic, comic-book.

params.label: Dot count
params.effect: How many dots span the frame; low is bold and chunky, high is a fine comic screen.

params.label: Flow
params.effect: Drift speed of the colour blocks rolling across the dots; 0 holds them still.

params.label: Dot size
params.effect: Dot coverage; low leaves an airy grid on the ground, high nearly fills it solid.

params.label: Ground
params.effect: Background tone — 0 is light newsprint (high-key), 1 a dark ground for neon dots.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer pushes the colour field; 0 ignores the mouse.
